fullText.simplified:
十三、陪伴更重要

    我的学生告诉多多，他能治好我的病了，我可以从沉睡中醒来了。
    “太好了，爸爸，你终于可以回家了！”
    多多高兴极了，我也很高兴，但我们的高兴不一样。我对从沉睡中醒来这件事已经没那么关心了，我高兴是因为多多高兴。
    “多多，我们的聊天数据你都存好了吗？”
    “存好了！等你醒来就给你看。”多多高兴地说。
    “太好了。那等我醒来，你就把我在网络中的数据都删掉吧。”
    “爸爸，你说什么？删掉数据，你就不存在了！”
    “不存在的只是网络中的数字人。在你的世界，爸爸已经回来了。”
    “数字人不能同时存在吗？”
    “你不需要同时有两个爸爸。”
    “两个爸爸？”多多不说话了，她可能从来没有想过这个问题，她一直觉得我和那个沉睡的爸爸是同一个人。
    但我们不是同一个人，网络中的我有和多多的全部记忆，沉睡的那个我没有。沉睡的这十九年里发生了很多事情，多多早就不是十九年前的多多了，我也不是十九年前的我了。那个从沉睡中醒来的我是十九年前的样子，他只是过去的我。
    过了很久，多多说：“两千年前，有人问过一个问题。一只一直航行的船，部件坏了就换新的，等全部的部件都被换过后，这只船还是以前的那只船吗？还是已经变成了一只不同的船？爸爸，你听过这个问题吗？”
    “我听过。我觉得是不是同一只船不重要，两只船都陪伴人完成了航行，这更重要。”
    “所以是陪伴更重要？”
    “是的，陪伴更重要。多多，删掉数据后，我不是不见了，而是回到了你的世界。那个醒来后的爸爸和我是一样的，他只是没有沉睡以后的记忆，你能把这十多年里的事情都告诉他吗？如果你同意，我会很高兴，我想他也会高兴，因为我相信他和我的想法是一样的。”
fullText.traditional:
十三、陪伴更重要

    我的學生告訴多多，他能治好我的病了，我可以從沉睡中醒來了。
    “太好了，爸爸，你終於可以回家了！”
    多多高興極了，我也很高興，但我們的高興不一樣。我對從沉睡中醒來這件事已經沒那麼關心了，我高興是因為多多高興。
    “多多，我們的聊天數據你都存好了嗎？”
    “存好了！等你醒來就給你看。”多多高興地說。
    “太好了。那等我醒來，你就把我在網絡中的數據都刪掉吧。”
    “爸爸，你說什麼？刪掉數據，你就不存在了！”
    “不存在的只是網絡中的數字人。在你的世界，爸爸已經回來了。”
    “數字人不能同時存在嗎？”
    “你不需要同時有兩個爸爸。”
    “兩個爸爸？”多多不說話了，她可能從來沒有想過這個問題，她一直覺得我和那個沉睡的爸爸是同一個人。
    但我們不是同一個人，網絡中的我有和多多的全部記憶，沉睡的那個我沒有。沉睡的這十九年裡發生了很多事情，多多早就不是十九年前的多多了，我也不是十九年前的我了。那個從沉睡中醒來的我是十九年前的樣子，他只是過去的我。
    過了很久，多多說：“兩千年前，有人問過一個問題。一隻一直航行的船，部件壞了就換新的，等全部的部件都被換過後，這隻船還是以前的那隻船嗎？還是已經變成了一隻不同的船？爸爸，你聽過這個問題嗎？”
    “我聽過。我覺得是不是同一隻船不重要，兩隻船都陪伴人完成了航行，這更重要。”
    “所以是陪伴更重要？”
    “是的，陪伴更重要。多多，刪掉數據後，我不是不見了，而是回到了你的世界。那個醒來後的爸爸和我是一樣的，他只是沒有沉睡以後的記憶，你能把這十多年裡的事情都告訴他嗎？如果你同意，我會很高興，我想他也會高興，因為我相信他和我的想法是一樣的。”

sentences.english: My student told Duoduo that he could cure my illness now, and I could wake up from my deep sleep.

sentences.simplified: “太好了，爸爸，你终于可以回家了！”
sentences.traditional: “太好了，爸爸，你終於可以回家了！”
sentences.pinyin: tài hǎo le bà ba nǐ zhōng yú kě yǐ huí jiā le
sentences.english: “Great, Dad, you can finally come home!”

sentences.simplified: 多多高兴极了，我也很高兴，但我们的高兴不一样。
sentences.traditional: 多多高興極了，我也很高興，但我們的高興不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō gāo xìng jí le wǒ yě hěn gāo xìng dàn wǒ men de gāo xìng bù yí yàng
sentences.english: Duoduo was extremely happy, and I was also very happy, but our happiness was different.

sentences.simplified: 我对从沉睡中醒来这件事已经没那么关心了，我高兴是因为多多高兴。
sentences.traditional: 我對從沉睡中醒來這件事已經沒那麼關心了，我高興是因為多多高興。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ duì cóng chén shuì zhōng xǐng lái zhè jiàn shì yǐ jīng méi nà me guān xīn le wǒ gāo xìng shì yīn wèi duō duō gāo xìng
sentences.english: I no longer cared so much about waking up from my deep sleep. I was happy because Duoduo was happy.

sentences.simplified: “多多，我们的聊天数据你都存好了吗？”
sentences.traditional: “多多，我們的聊天數據你都存好了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: duō duō wǒ men de liáo tiān shù jù nǐ dōu cún hǎo le ma
sentences.english: “Duoduo, have you saved all our chat data?”

sentences.simplified: “存好了！等你醒来就给你看。”多多高兴地说。
sentences.traditional: “存好了！等你醒來就給你看。”多多高興地說。
sentences.pinyin: cún hǎo le děng nǐ xǐng lái jiù gěi nǐ kàn duō duō gāo xìng de shuō
sentences.english: “I’ve saved it! When you wake up, I’ll show you,” Duoduo said happily.

sentences.simplified: “太好了。那等我醒来，你就把我在网络中的数据都删掉吧。”
sentences.traditional: “太好了。那等我醒來，你就把我在網絡中的數據都刪掉吧。”
sentences.pinyin: tài hǎo le nà děng wǒ xǐng lái nǐ jiù bǎ wǒ zài wǎng luò zhōng de shù jù dōu shān diào ba
sentences.english: “Great. Then, when I wake up, delete all my data from the network.”

sentences.simplified: “爸爸，你说什么？删掉数据，你就不存在了！”
sentences.traditional: “爸爸，你說什麼？刪掉數據，你就不存在了！”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba nǐ shuō shén me shān diào shù jù nǐ jiù bù cún zài le
sentences.english: “Dad, what are you saying? If I delete the data, you cease to exist!”

sentences.simplified: “不存在的只是网络中的数字人。在你的世界，爸爸已经回来了。”
sentences.traditional: “不存在的只是網絡中的數字人。在你的世界，爸爸已經回來了。”
sentences.pinyin: bù cún zài de zhǐ shì wǎng luò zhōng de shù zì rén zài nǐ de shì jiè bà ba yǐ jīng huí lái le
sentences.english: “What won’t exist is just a digital human on the network. In your world, your dad will already be back.”

sentences.simplified: “数字人不能同时存在吗？”
sentences.traditional: “數字人不能同時存在嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: shù zì rén bù néng tóng shí cún zài ma
sentences.english: “Can’t digital humans exist at the same time?”

sentences.simplified: “你不需要同时有两个爸爸。”
sentences.traditional: “你不需要同時有兩個爸爸。”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bù xū yào tóng shí yǒu liǎng ge bà ba
sentences.english: “You don’t need to have two dads at the same time.”

sentences.simplified: “两个爸爸？”多多不说话了，她可能从来没有想过这个问题，
sentences.traditional: “兩個爸爸？”多多不說話了，她可能從來沒有想過這個問題，
sentences.pinyin: liǎng ge bà ba duō duō bù shuō huà le tā kě néng cóng lái méi yǒu xiǎng guò zhè ge wèn tí
sentences.english: “Two dads?” Duoduo stopped talking. Maybe she had never thought about this question.

sentences.pinyin: tā yì zhí jué de wǒ hé nà ge chén shuì de bà ba shì tóng yī ge rén
sentences.english: She had always thought that I was the same person as the deep-sleeping dad.

sentences.simplified: 但我们不是同一个人，网络中的我有和多多的全部记忆，沉睡的那个我没有。
sentences.traditional: 但我們不是同一個人，網絡中的我有和多多的全部記憶，沉睡的那個我沒有。
sentences.pinyin: dàn wǒ men bú shì tóng yī ge rén wǎng luò zhōng de wǒ yǒu hé duō duō de quán bù jì yì chén shuì de nà ge wǒ méi yǒu
sentences.english: But we were not the same person. The me on the network had all the memories of Duoduo, but the deep sleeping me did not.

sentences.simplified: 沉睡的这十九年里发生了很多事情，
sentences.traditional: 沉睡的這十九年裡發生了很多事情，
sentences.pinyin: chén shuì de zhè shí jiǔ nián lǐ fā shēng le hěn duō shì qing
sentences.english: A lot of things happened during these nineteen years of deep sleep.

sentences.simplified: 多多早就不是十九年前的多多了，我也不是十九年前的我了。
sentences.traditional: 多多早就不是十九年前的多多了，我也不是十九年前的我了。
sentences.pinyin: duō duō zǎo jiù bú shì shí jiǔ nián qián de duō duō le wǒ yě bú shì shí jiǔ nián qián de wǒ le
sentences.english: Duoduo was no longer the Duoduo of nineteen years ago, and I was no longer the me of nineteen years ago.

sentences.simplified: 那个从沉睡中醒来的我是十九年前的样子，他只是过去的我。
sentences.traditional: 那個從沉睡中醒來的我是十九年前的樣子，他只是過去的我。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge cóng chén shuì zhōng xǐng lái de wǒ shì shí jiǔ nián qián de yàng zi tā zhǐ shì guò qù de wǒ
sentences.english: The person waking up from deep sleep was the me of nineteen years ago. He was merely my past self.

sentences.simplified: 过了很久，多多说：“两千年前，有人问过一个问题。
sentences.traditional: 過了很久，多多說：“兩千年前，有人問過一個問題。
sentences.pinyin: guò le hěn jiǔ duō duō shuō liǎng qiān nián qián yǒu rén wèn guò yí ge wèn tí
sentences.english: After a long time, Duoduo said, “Two thousand years ago, someone asked a question.

sentences.simplified: 一只一直航行的船，部件坏了就换新的，
sentences.traditional: 一隻一直航行的船，部件壞了就換新的，
sentences.pinyin: yì zhī yì zhí háng xíng de chuán bù jiàn huài le jiù huàn xīn de
sentences.english: A ship that has been sailing continuously has its parts replaced with new ones whenever they break.

sentences.simplified: 等全部的部件都被换过后，这只船还是以前的那只船吗？还是已经变成了一只不同的船？
sentences.traditional: 等全部的部件都被換過後，這隻船還是以前的那隻船嗎？還是已經變成了一隻不同的船？
sentences.pinyin: děng quán bù de bù jiàn dōu bèi huàn guò hòu zhè zhī chuán hái shì yǐ qián de nà zhī chuán ma hái shi yǐ jīng biàn chéng le yì zhī bù tóng de chuán
sentences.english: Once all the parts have been replaced, is it still the same ship as before? Or has it become a different ship?

sentences.simplified: 爸爸，你听过这个问题吗？”
sentences.traditional: 爸爸，你聽過這個問題嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba nǐ tīng guò zhè ge wèn tí ma
sentences.english: Dad, have you heard of this question before?”

sentences.simplified: “我听过。我觉得是不是同一只船不重要，
sentences.traditional: “我聽過。我覺得是不是同一隻船不重要，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tīng guò wǒ jué de shì bú shì tóng yī zhī chuán bú zhòng yào
sentences.english: “I have heard of it. I think it doesn’t matter whether it is the same ship or not.

sentences.simplified: 两只船都陪伴人完成了航行，这更重要。”
sentences.traditional: 兩隻船都陪伴人完成了航行，這更重要。”
sentences.pinyin: liǎng zhī chuán dōu péi bàn rén wán chéng le háng xíng zhè gèng zhòng yào
sentences.english: What is more important is that both ships accompanied people to complete their voyage.”

sentences.simplified: “所以是陪伴更重要？”
sentences.traditional: “所以是陪伴更重要？”
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ shì péi bàn gèng zhòng yào
sentences.english: “So companionship is more important?”

sentences.simplified: “是的，陪伴更重要。多多，删掉数据后，我不是不见了，而是回到了你的世界。
sentences.traditional: “是的，陪伴更重要。多多，刪掉數據後，我不是不見了，而是回到了你的世界。
sentences.pinyin: shì de péi bàn gèng zhòng yào duō duō shān diào shù jù hòu wǒ bú shì bú jiàn le ér shì huí dào le nǐ de shì jiè
sentences.english: “Yes, companionship is more important. Duoduo, after deleting the data, I haven’t disappeared. Instead, I’ve returned to your world.

sentences.simplified: 那个醒来后的爸爸和我是一样的，他只是没有沉睡以后的记忆，
sentences.traditional: 那個醒來後的爸爸和我是一樣的，他只是沒有沉睡以後的記憶，
sentences.pinyin: nà ge xǐng lái hòu de bà ba hé wǒ shì yí yàng de tā zhǐ shì méi yǒu chén shuì yǐ hòu de jì yì
sentences.english: The dad who wakes up is the same as me. He just doesn’t have the memories from after he fell asleep.

sentences.simplified: 你能把这十多年里的事情都告诉他吗？
sentences.traditional: 你能把這十多年裡的事情都告訴他嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ néng bǎ zhè shí duō nián lǐ de shì qing dōu gào su tā ma
sentences.english: Can you tell him everything that happened over these more than ten years?

sentences.simplified: 如果你同意，我会很高兴，我想他也会高兴，因为我相信他和我的想法是一样的。”
sentences.traditional: 如果你同意，我會很高興，我想他也會高興，因為我相信他和我的想法是一樣的。”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ tóng yì wǒ huì hěn gāo xìng wǒ xiǎng tā yě huì gāo xìng yīn wèi wǒ xiāng xìn tā hé wǒ de xiǎng fǎ shì yí yàng de
sentences.english: If you agree, I would be very happy, and I think he would be happy too, because I believe he and I think the same way.”

sentence_translations: (13) Companionship is More Important
My student told Duoduo that he could cure my illness now, and I could wake up from my deep sleep.
“Great, Dad, you can finally come home!”
Duoduo was extremely happy, and I was also very happy, but our happiness was different.
I no longer cared so much about waking up from my deep sleep. I was happy because Duoduo was happy.
“Duoduo, have you saved all our chat data?”
“I’ve saved it! When you wake up, I’ll show you,” Duoduo said happily.
“Great. Then, when I wake up, delete all my data from the network.”
“Dad, what are you saying? If I delete the data, you cease to exist!”
“What won’t exist is just a digital human on the network. In your world, your dad will already be back.”
“Can’t digital humans exist at the same time?”
“You don’t need to have two dads at the same time.”
“Two dads?” Duoduo stopped talking. Maybe she had never thought about this question.
She had always thought that I was the same person as the deep-sleeping dad.
But we were not the same person. The me on the network had all the memories of Duoduo, but the deep sleeping me did not.
A lot of things happened during these nineteen years of deep sleep.
Duoduo was no longer the Duoduo of nineteen years ago, and I was no longer the me of nineteen years ago.
The person waking up from deep sleep was the me of nineteen years ago. He was merely my past self.
After a long time, Duoduo said, “Two thousand years ago, someone asked a question.
A ship that has been sailing continuously has its parts replaced with new ones whenever they break.
Once all the parts have been replaced, is it still the same ship as before? Or has it become a different ship?
Dad, have you heard of this question before?”
“I have heard of it. I think it doesn’t matter whether it is the same ship or not.
What is more important is that both ships accompanied people to complete their voyage.”
“So companionship is more important?”
“Yes, companionship is more important. Duoduo, after deleting the data, I haven’t disappeared. Instead, I’ve returned to your world.
The dad who wakes up is the same as me. He just doesn’t have the memories from after he fell asleep.
Can you tell him everything that happened over these more than ten years?
If you agree, I would be very happy, and I think he would be happy too, because I believe he and I think the same way.”
